name: h10_chain_ccpvdz_j
description: #486: an H10 chain -- five H2 on z, bond 1.4 bohr, 4.0 bohr between molecules -- in cc-pVDZ, Cartesian, with PySCF's converged RHF density recorded: the first fixture whose density decays with distance (#484's per-block density factor can fire on it). Records the converted basis and PySCF's get_jk J for the recorded density.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h10_chain_ccpvdz_j

density_recipe: rhf: PySCF's converged closed-shell RHF density (total, 2 C_occ C_occ^T, symmetrised as (D + D^T) / 2; conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), recorded; every array is computed from the recorded matrix, which --check holds to 1e-08 of a fresh SCF, not bitwise
